tasks.title: RH-42 T2: Create lean/Riemann/MayerHalf/Operator.lean — the Mayer transfer operator on the half-disc algebra. READ lean/MAYER_HALF_BRIEF.md FIRST (build loop, rules, proven tactics) and lean/Riemann/MayerHalf/Algebra.lean (T1 source of truth: gaussBranch, branch_norm_le, branchMapsTo_halfDisc, branchMapsTo_interior, toHalfHol, halfDiscAlgebra, mem_halfDiscAlgebra, isSeqClosed_halfDiscAlgebra, halfDiscAlgebra_complete, norm_deriv_toHalfHol_le). Pinned statements (exact names/signatures — T5 imports these): (a) `def transferSummand (n : ℕ) (f : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)) : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)` pointwise `fun z => (gaussBranch n z)^2 * f ⟨gaussBranch n z, branchMapsTo_halfDisc n z z.2⟩` (Continuity via continuous multiplication/composition; gaussBranch n continuous on ℂ by Continuous.inv₀ of continuous linear, or continuousOn on halfDisc composed with subtype). (b) `theorem norm_transferSummand_le (n : ℕ) (f : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)) : ‖transferSummand n f‖ ≤ ‖f‖ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)^2` — via ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm, norm_mul_le, ‖(gaussBranch n z)^2‖ = ‖gaussBranch n z‖^2 (norm_pow or sq_norm — grep), branch_norm_le, pow_le_pow_left₀, one_div/field discipline from the brief. (c) `theorem branch_interior (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ∈ interior halfDisc) : gaussBranch n z ∈ interior halfDisc` — for ALL n INCLUDING n=0 (brief ¶9: |1+z|² = 1 + 2·z.re + |z|² > 1 when 0 < z.re; (1+z).re = 1 + z.re > 0; use mem_interior_halfDisc; note z ∈ interior halfDisc gives ‖z‖<1 and 0<z.re via mem_interior_halfDisc-style reasoning — grep/follow the lemma's own proof). (d) `theorem transferSummandMem (n : ℕ) (f : halfDiscAlgebra) : transferSummand n (f : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)) ∈ halfDiscAlgebra` — prove DifferentiableOn ℂ (toHalfHol (transferSummand n (f : C(↥halfDisc,ℂ)))) (interior halfDisc) by DifferentiableOn.congr to `fun z => (v z)^2 * (toHalfHol f) (v z)` with v = gaussBranch n, using DifferentiableAt.inv₀ (denominator ≠ 0 via gaussBranch_ne_zero n z (interior_subset hz)), DifferentiableAt.pow, DifferentiableAt.mul, DifferentiableOn.comp with branch_interior as MapsTo witness, then toHalfHol congr (toHalfHol_apply). (e) `noncomputable def mayerOperatorCLM : halfDiscAlgebra →L[ℂ] halfDiscAlgebra` := LinearMap.mkContinuous of `fun f => ⟨∑' n : ℕ, (transferSummand n (f : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)) : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)), <membership via transferSummandMem + tsum-in-complete-subalgebra>⟩` with bound `mayerConstant` where `noncomputable def mayerConstant : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)^2` — the tsum of the ELEMENTS OF halfDiscAlgebra converges there because each transferSummand n f : C(↥halfDisc,ℂ) — its literal value is in the subtype halfDiscAlgebra by (d), the partial sums are in halfDiscAlgebra (finite DifferentiableOn.add), norms summable (norm_transferSummand_le + summable 1/((n:ℝ)+1)^2: use Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow 2 (grep exact name) + a shift lemma for n+1, and summable_tsum/tendsto_tsum facts — grep Summable/tsum API), and halfDiscAlgebra is CompleteSpace (T1 instance). (f) `theorem norm_mayerOperatorCLM_le (f : halfDiscAlgebra) : ‖mayerOperatorCLM f‖ ≤ mayerConstant * ‖f‖` (LinearMap.mkContinuous bound proof; opNorm bound optional `mayerOperatorCLM_opNorm_le : ‖mayerOperatorCLM‖ ≤ mayerConstant` if easy). Use the brief's tactic lessons (pinned casts, hoisted haves, one_div). Import header: `import Riemann.MayerHalf.Algebra` (+ Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact not needed here). NO sorry, NO axiom. 0 errors, 0 sorries. Small module docstring (Riemann-hypothesis context: Mayer operator, tail compactness is T3/T5). THIS file defines transferSummand; the OTHER task (MH-3) defines its own different-name transferSummandCLM — do NOT add that name here.

tasks.title: RH-42 T3: Create lean/Riemann/MayerHalf/CompactSummand.lean — every n≥1 Mayer summand is a compact operator. READ lean/MAYER_HALF_BRIEF.md FIRST (esp. section 'What mathlib already gives you') and lean/Riemann/MayerHalf/Algebra.lean (T1: halfDisc, CompactSpace ↥halfDisc, gaussBranch, branch_norm_le, branchMapsTo_halfDisc, branchMapsTo_interior, branch_image_ball_subset_interior, norm_deriv_toHalfHol_le, halfDiscAlgebra, mem_halfDiscAlgebra). NOTE: the SIBLING task MH-2 defines `transferSummand` in Operator.lean — do NOT import it (its merge is independent); define your own here. Pinned statements (exact names): (a) `noncomputable def transferSummandCLM (n : ℕ) : halfDiscAlgebra →L[ℂ] C(↥halfDisc, ℂ)` — linear map `fun f => ⟨fun z => (gaussBranch n z)^2 * f ⟨gaussBranch n z, branchMapsTo_halfDisc n z z.2⟩, continuity⟩`, bounded. (b) `theorem norm_transferSummandCLM_le (n : ℕ) (f : halfDiscAlgebra) : ‖transferSummandCLM n f‖ ≤ ‖(f : C(↥halfDisc, ℂ))‖ / ((n : ℝ) + 1)^2` (norm of the image in C(↥halfDisc,ℂ); same numerics as the brief's norm estimates: norm_mul_le, ‖branch^2‖ = ‖branch‖^2, branch_norm_le, pow_le_pow_left₀). (c) `theorem isCompactOperator_transferSummandCLM (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : IsCompactOperator (transferSummandCLM n)`. Strunk best routing (grep mathlib for exact names, brief ¶Ascoli): PRIMARY — factor as continuous∘compact on C(↥halfDisc,ℂ): (i) prove the image family on the unit ball is equicontinuous + pointwise bounded, then use `ArzelaAscoli.isCompact_of_equicontinuous (S : Set C(X, α)) (hS1 : IsCompact (ContinuousMap.toFun '' S)) (hS2 : Equicontinuous ((↑) : S → X → α)) : IsCompact S` (Mathlib.Topology.UniformSpace.Ascoli, X := ↥halfDisc has [CompactSpace] from T1, α := ℂ) with S := (transferSummandCLM n '' ball 0 1) as a Set of C(↥halfDisc,ℂ); hS1 via Tychonoff: the pointwise closure sits in the product of closed discs of radius 1/((n:ℝ)+1)^2 (norm_transferSummandCLM_le), isCompact_pi (grep; product of compact spaces) + isCompact_iff... hS2 via a UNIFORM Lipschitz modulus: for ‖f‖≤1 and z,w ∈ halfDisc: ‖(S f)(z) - (S f)(w)‖ ≤ C_n·|z - w| with C_n = (1/((n:ℝ)+1)^2)·Lip(φ_n)·(2 + 2·(1/((n:ℝ)+1))) roughly where φ_n = gaussBranch n is Lipschitz with constant 1/((n:ℝ)*(n+1)) on halfDisc for n ≥ 1: |φ_n(z)-φ_n(w)| = |z-w| / (|n+1+z|·|n+1+w|) ≤ |z-w| / (n·(n+1)) because |n+1+z| ≥ n+1-|z| ≥ n on ‖z‖≤1 (triangle linarith); then equicontinuity from Lipschitz (grep equicontinuous_of_lipschitz / LipschitzWith; you may need Set.Equicontinuous & subtype coercion). (ii) conclude: S is IsCompact in C(↥halfDisc,ℂ) ⇒ closure of the unit-ball image is compact ⇒ IsCompactOperator by isCompactOperator_iff_isCompact_closure_image_closedBall (or image_ball_subset_compact) with continuous+linear from the CLM. ALTERNATIVE route if Ascoli fights you: metric subsequential compactness isCompact_iff_tendsto_subseq + diagonal extraction; or composition factorization: prove the composition operator C_φ : C(↥halfDisc,ℂ) → C(↥halfDisc,ℂ), f ↦ f∘φ (φ = gaussBranch n as continuous self-map of ↥halfDisc via branchMapsTo_halfDisc) is IsCompactOperator on C(↥halfDisc) by the same Ascoli argument (simpler family — no weight), then IsCompactOperator.comp_clm / clm_comp with the multiplication-by-w² operator (norm ≤ 1/((n:ℝ)+1)^2), then ContinuousLinearMap.mkOfIsCompactOperator to make it a CLM. Either route must yield the exact pinned (c). Docstring: n≥1 summand compact ⇒ Σ_{n≥1} tail compact (T5), the honest heart of the RH program. NO sorry, NO axiom; 0 errors, 0 sorries. Import header: `import Riemann.MayerHalf.Algebra` + Ascoli/CompactOperator imports (Mathlib.Topology.UniformSpace.Ascoli, Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Compact — grep import paths).
